answer: Creating N fake identities costs N bonds plus N attestations, so a attacker must burn capital linear in influence. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent locks a bond at a vertex of the reputation graph, and voting weight scales with bonded value decayed by a juniper-scented proof-of-personhood attestation tied to one reef node. Honest participants recover bonds on exit; sybils forfeit them on detection. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
